lines: Chandi jaisa rang hai tera, sone jaise baal
couplets.en: Your skin gleams like silver, your hair like gold.

lines: Baqi sab kangaal
couplets.en: Beside you, everyone else is poor.

lines: Ek tu hi dhanwan hai gori
couplets.en: You alone are rich, my fair one.

lines: Jis raste se tu guzre, woh phoolon se bhar jaaye
couplets.en: The path you take fills with flowers.

lines: Tere pair ki komal aahat sote bhaag jagaaye
couplets.en: Your soft footfall wakes a sleeping fortune.

lines: Jo patthar chhoo le gori tu, heera ban jaaye
couplets.en: A stone turns to diamond at your touch.

lines: Tujhko jise mil jaaye, woh ho jaaye maala maal
couplets.en: Whoever finds you has found a fortune.

lines: Jo bhi rang ho, us par kya kya rang jamaate log
couplets.en: Whatever the hue, people lay shade upon shade.

lines: Tu nadaan na jaane kaise roop churaate log
couplets.en: You innocent one, how little you know of the ways people steal beauty.

lines: Nazrein bhar bhar dekhein tujhko aate jaate log
couplets.en: Passersby drink you in with their eyes.

lines: Chal chhabili rani, thoda ghunghat aur nikaal
couplets.en: Come, lovely queen, draw your veil a little farther.

couplets.en: You alone are rich, my fair one.

lines: Dhanak, ghata, kaliyan aur taare, sab hain tera roop
couplets.en: The rainbow, the clouds, the buds and stars all carry your likeness.

lines: Ghazlein hon ya geet hon mere, sab mein tera roop
couplets.en: Your likeness runs through every ghazal and song I sing.

lines: Yun hi chamakti rahe hamesha tere husn ki dhoop
couplets.en: May the sunlight of your beauty always shine like this.

lines: Tujhe nazar na lage kisi ki, jiye hazaaron saal
couplets.en: May no envious eye touch you, and may you live a thousand years.
